cards.card_text: Next, Moses is to dress Aaron in the garments, from the tunic to the turban with its holy diadem, and anoint him by pouring oil on his head.
cards.verse_text: Put the turban on his head and attach the holy diadem to the turban.
cards.snippet: Put the turban on his head and attach the holy diadem to the turban.

cards.card_text: A gold plate called the holy diadem Two onyx stones set in gold A golden bell and a pomegranate
cards.verse_text: Moses also put the turban on Aaron’s head and set the gold plate, the holy diadem, on the front of the turban, as the LORD had commanded him.
cards.snippet: …the turban on Aaron’s head and set the gold plate, the holy diadem, on the front of the turban, as the LORD had commanded him.

cards.card_text: Then the picture flips: on that day the LORD of Hosts will be a crown of glory, a diadem of splendor.
cards.verse_text: On that day the LORD of Hosts will be a crown of glory, a diadem of splendor to the remnant of His people,
cards.snippet: …day the LORD of Hosts will be a crown of glory, a diadem of splendor to the remnant of His people,

cards.card_text: Zion will be a crown of glory, a royal diadem.
cards.verse_text: You will be a crown of glory in the hand of the LORD, a royal diadem in the palm of your God.
cards.snippet: …a crown of glory in the hand of the LORD, a royal diadem in the palm of your God.
